scope_notes: All isolated branches start at baseline b12f0f8760a3e88e9539b0c8cfd32b38a5297c68 and extract exactly one value-backed field family from the combined candidate.
retained isolates inline Q128 ProjectTier and RewardManager values while preserving nil/present-zero state and detached copy semantics; baseline active reward aggregation remains unchanged.
debt isolates inline RewardState price debt while preserving nil/present-zero state and detached copy semantics; v1 and upgrade-v3 claimability helpers reuse one detached getter result.

The shared public fixture uses identical inputs across variants: 256 deposits, 1/10/100 paid reward-claim patterns (111 separate calls), 256 withdrawals, and a separately measured admin refund.

State snapshots and deterministic clock lines are outside paid-call metric windows; final assertions require zero active deposits, rewards, and staked GNS before and after admin refund (launchpad has no tick state), while retired history may persist.
